title: Sudoku without a loop
summary: A sudoku solved with no loop over cells: the rules as a table of units, every cell's candidates as one mask, every single found at once, and a move as a mask added to the grid, repeated until nothing changes. Ends on the live page.

scenes.heading: Sudoku, without a loop
scenes.narration: A sudoku, solved with no loop over cells. Every cell is worked on at once.
lines: Every cell at once, as arrays.

scenes.heading: 1. The rules are a table
scenes.narration: First, the rules become a table. Nine rows, nine columns and nine boxes, each a list of its cells. One select and one sum count every digit in every unit.
lines: Each unit's cells, and the digits it holds already.

scenes.heading: 2. Every cell's candidates
scenes.narration: Next, the candidates of every cell at once. A digit is open where none of the three units of that cell holds it. This cell can be one, two or four.
lines: Open where none of the cell's three units holds it.

scenes.heading: 3. A move is a mask
scenes.narration: Then find every single at once. A cell with one candidate left, or a digit with one place left in a unit. The move is a mask of digits, added to the grid in one step.

lines.xtl: naked := (0 < c) & (1 = '+ r_/_2 c) '* t_able 9 r_eshape 1

lines: One candidate left, or one place left in a unit.
Every single's digit, added to the grid at once.

scenes.heading: 4. Round after round
scenes.narration: Repeat that round until nothing changes. Five rounds, and the puzzle is solved. When rounds stall, the solver guesses and backs up.
lines: Every single, every round, until the grid stops changing.
